GETTING STARTED

A clear start.
A smoother workflow.

Install NexaTik, load the right links and keep your downloads organized.

01 · Install02 · Load videos03 · Download & ZIP04 · Dates & scheduling05 · Updates06 · Troubleshooting
01

Install the complete setup

Download NexaTik-Setup-0.5.2.exe for 64-bit Windows. Finish or cancel any active work in an existing installation, close NexaTik and run the setup. Python does not need to be installed separately.

The installer supplies the application and its runtime files. Use this complete setup when installing on another computer.

Open download center
02

Choose a platform, then load your links

Select YouTube, Facebook, Instagram or TikTok. For one video, paste its full HTTPS link. For a collection, use Profile / Bulk or Paste bulk links, then choose Load videos.

YouTube channel handles automatically use Profile / Bulk. Instagram profile links open a Chrome Reels scan; complete any required login or verification in that browser and return to the requested profile. The visible scan can wait up to three minutes.

Profile access differs between platforms. A profile scan can return only the videos currently accessible to that session.
03

Select, download and organize

Tick the videos you want, choose a destination folder and click Download selected. Watch each entry's final state. Completed is different from a loaded thumbnail or a preview.

Matching text files preserve titles and available descriptions. With Automatically create batch ZIP enabled, the completed batch is packaged after downloading. Failed and partial items do not belong in the completed ZIP.

04

Separate upload dates from download time

Open Dates / Schedule before loading videos. Upload-date From / To selects when videos were originally published; entries with unavailable dates are excluded when filtering is active.

The future date/time schedules when the selected download batch starts. Keep NexaTik open, the laptop awake and the internet connected. Closing the app cancels its pending schedule.

05

Check for updates in the app

Version 0.5.0 and later include an Updates button. A higher stable release can offer Install update. Finish active or scheduled work before installation. The app downloads and verifies the setup before the installation handoff.

If your installed version is current, an up-to-date result is expected. A first installation on an older computer still needs the complete setup.

06

If a link does not load

  • Confirm the selected platform matches your link.
  • Use a video link for Single Video; a profile needs an accessible profile list.
  • Review upload-date filters if the list is empty.
  • Complete browser login or verification only on the platform's own page.
  • Read Activity Log for the actual error and note the platform, URL and app version.

Some content may be private, unavailable, restricted or temporarily blocked. NexaTik does not bypass access permissions, and downloads cannot be guaranteed for every URL.
